as_told.title: Ingo Swann spied on the ONI remote viewing program for Scientology
as_told.place_text: Office of Naval Intelligence remote viewing program

plain: In the 1970s, the lawyer Dan Sheehan says, Ingo Swann, a psychic who took part in government remote viewing work (attempts to see distant places with the mind alone), was filing reports to the Church of Scientology's Guardian's Office, its intelligence arm, at its head office in the UK. According to Sheehan, the reports described "the entire internal operations" of the remote viewing program run by the Office of Naval Intelligence, the Navy's intelligence service. Sheehan tells Michels on two episodes that he saw these reports himself. If true, a secret military psychic program was being reported to a church.
